response.overview: Cupid Co., Ltd. is a company that specializes in helping individuals find true love. When someone becomes the object of affection by our employees, known as 'cupids,' they are matched with a romantic partner. However, the price for this service is that the cupids themselves remain perpetually single. Qiuzhi Xiang, a rookie cupid longing for love, is determined to break free from the curse of singleness and embark on a journey to find his own happiness.
response.title: Cupid Co., Ltd.
